# Superoutine

> Superoutine (also searched as "Super Routine") is an AI habit tracker and routine planner. It helps people build daily routines with XP levels, streaks, an AI coach and progress analytics.

- Price: Pro is $4.99/month, $39/year, or $79 one-time lifetime (first 100 buyers). Prices in USD.
- Trial: 15-day free trial with every feature, no card needed. After the trial the app is locked until a plan is chosen; data is kept.
- Platforms: Web app for any modern browser on desktop, iPhone and Android. No native app-store apps.
- Key features: daily 31-day habit grid, weekly habits, XP and levels, streaks with 3 streak protections a month, AI Coach chat that reads your progress, daily AI lessons, routines with 5 ready-made packs, to-do list, focus timer, Momentum Meter, Comeback Score, notifications inbox, 3-level referral program (10% / 2% / 0.5%).
